title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Overview (Item 7)
key_points: Company states FY2022 net revenue grew 44% to $23.6B from $16.4B, driven by +64% Data Center, +21% Gaming, and Embedded growth from Xilinx inclusion, partly offset by a 10% Client decline.
Company attributes the gross margin decline (45% vs 48%) primarily to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
Company attributes the operating income decline ($1.3B vs $3.6B) primarily to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
Net income decline is attributed to lower operating income.
Xilinx acquisition completed in February 2022.
raw_excerpt: Gross margin, as a percentage of net revenue for 2022, was 45%, compared to 48% in 2021. The decrease in gross margin was primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition. Operating income for 2022 was $1.3 billion compared to operating income of $3.6 billion for 2021. The decrease in operating income was primarily driven by amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Results of Operations: segment drivers (Client units/ASP, Gaming, Embedded)
key_points: In Q2 fiscal 2022 AMD changed its reporting segments to align with how the CODM manages the business in strategic end markets.
Client net revenue of $6.2 billion in 2022 decreased 10%, driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipments, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.
The unit shipment decrease was due to challenging PC market conditions and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain.
Data Center net revenue of $6 billion in 2022 increased 64%, primarily driven by higher EPYC server processor sales.
Gaming net revenue of $6.8 billion in 2022 increased 21%, driven by higher semi-custom product sales, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales.
Embedded net revenue of $4.6 billion in 2022 increased significantly versus $246 million in 2021, primarily due to inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue.
